name: The Mother of My Best Friend and Her Irresistible Desires
source:
A quick visual novel about two single moms and their different kids in Naples, Florida. One’s a troublemaker, the other's just along for the ride, and a hot weekend stirs up family drama and some secrets.

[From [url=https://17moonkeys.itch.io/themotherofmybestfriendandherirresistibledesires05]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于佛罗里达州那不勒斯的两位单亲妈妈和她们不同的孩子的快速视觉小说。一个是麻烦制造者，另一个只是凑热闹，炎热的周末引发了家庭戏剧和一些秘密。

[来自[url=https://17moonkeys.itch.io/themotherofmybestfriendandherirresistibledesires05]Itch.io[/url]]
